description: Rewrite PageGuide.tsx to cover all 57 routes from the spec. Adds getTourId() mapping function, per-tour localStorage persistence (nodbusiness-tour-<ID>-done) with backwards compat for the old nodbusiness-page-guide-seen key, full buildSteps() switch covering every TOUR_ID, all English copy, all Amharic copy, and wait-for-element polling (100ms, 2000ms max) with graceful skip. FEAT-002 depends on FEAT-001: the data-page-guide attributes must exist before this runs. No other files are changed in this FEAT.
steps: 1. Read the current frontend-next/components/PageGuide.tsx in full before making any changes.
2. Read frontend-next/project-brain/MASTER_TOUR_PROMPT.md Parts E (step copy) and I (buildSteps code pattern) in full. This is the authoritative source for all copy text.

3. Add getTourId(pathname: string): string pure function BEFORE the copy object. Map every route from Part A of the spec: /landing->LANDING, /login->LOGIN, /register->REGISTER, /onboarding->ONBOARD, /forgot-password->FORGOT, /reset-password->RESET, /choose-account->CHOOSE-ACCT, /choose-mode->CHOOSE-MODE, /feed->FEED, /explore->EXPLORE, /search->SEARCH, /marketplace->MARKETPLACE, /products/create->PRODUCT-CREATE, /products/edit->PRODUCT-EDIT, /products/scan->PRODUCT-SCAN, /products/:id->PRODUCT-DETAIL, /businesses->BUSINESSES, /business/create->BIZ-CREATE, /business/edit->BIZ-EDIT, /business/inventory->INVENTORY, /business/subscription->SUBSCRIPTION, /business/subscription/receipt/:id->SUB-RECEIPT, /business/subscription/return->SUB-RETURN, /showrooms->SHOWROOMS, /showroom/create->SHOWROOM-CREATE, /showroom/samples->SHOWROOM-SAMPLES, /showroom/templates->SHOWROOM-TEMPLATES, /showroom/:slug->SHOWROOM-VIEW, /showrooms/:id->SHOWROOM-VIEW, /profile->PROFILE-OWN, /profile/edit->PROFILE-EDIT, /profile/:id->PROFILE-OTHER, /p/:username->PROFILE-PUBLIC, /messages->MESSAGES, /messages/:id->CHATROOM, /notifications->NOTIFICATIONS, /friends->FRIENDS, /orders->ORDERS, /orders/success->ORDER-SUCCESS, /orders/cancel->ORDER-CANCEL, /order/:token->ORDER-TOKEN, /cart->CART, /wallet->WALLET, /bookmarks->BOOKMARKS, /nearby->NEARBY, /hashtag/:name->HASHTAG, /coupons->COUPONS, /referral->REFERRAL, /scorecard->SCORECARD, /analytics->ANALYTICS, /settings->SETTINGS, /account->ACCOUNT, /privacy->PRIVACY, /admin/devops->DEVOPS, /admin->ADMIN, default->GENERIC. Use startsWith() for dynamic segments; check more-specific prefixes BEFORE less-specific ones (e.g. /products/create before /products/).
4. Add 'const tourId = useMemo(() => getTourId(pathname), [pathname]);' inside the PageGuide component, after the pathname declaration.

5. Replace the auto-start localStorage check. OLD: if (!localStorage.getItem('nodbusiness-page-guide-seen')) setOpen(true); NEW: const tourKey = 'nodbusiness-tour-' + tourId + '-done'; const legacyKey = 'nodbusiness-page-guide-seen'; const legacyDone = (tourId === 'LANDING' || tourId === 'FEED') && localStorage.getItem(legacyKey) === 'true'; if (!localStorage.getItem(tourKey) && !legacyDone) setOpen(true);

6. Update close() to write per-tour key. OLD: localStorage.setItem('nodbusiness-page-guide-seen', 'true'); NEW: localStorage.setItem('nodbusiness-tour-' + tourId + '-done', 'true'); Add tourId to the useCallback dependency array.

7. Add wait-for-element retry logic to updatePosition. Add two refs before the component return: retryRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null) and retryCountRef = useRef(0). In updatePosition, after querySelector, if target is null AND retryCountRef.current < 20: increment retryCountRef.current, set retryRef.current = setTimeout(() => updatePosition(scrollTarget), 100), and return. If target is still null after 20 retries: call console.warn('PageGuide: target not found', current.target), call advance(), and return. In the useEffect that watches [open, updatePosition] (step change), add: retryCountRef.current = 0; clearTimeout(retryRef.current ?? undefined); In the cleanup of that useEffect (return function), also clearTimeout(retryRef.current ?? undefined).

9. Add the same keys to copy.am.steps with Amharic translations. Translate each English title and body into Amharic, using the same concise register as the existing 14 Amharic keys. The copy object is 'as const' so all keys must be present in both en and am.

10. Replace the buildSteps() function body with a switch(tourId) covering all TOUR_IDs. Each case returns an array of make(key, target) calls. Use the exact data-page-guide target strings from MASTER_TOUR_PROMPT.md Part E. The default case returns the existing 3-step generic fallback. Preserve the isMobile conditional for the GENERIC case (mobile-navigation vs desktop-navigation). For FEED: include feedGuestBanner step in the array regardless; the wait-for-element retry will skip it gracefully if the element is absent (user is authenticated). Remove the now-redundant explicit checks for /landing, /marketplace, /search, /feed that currently exist in the function.

11. Run: cd frontend-next && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false. Fix any type errors (most likely StepKey type is inferred from 'as const' so no manual fix needed, but verify). Run npm run lint. Run npm run build.
12. Commit: 'feat(tours): rewrite PageGuide.tsx with full tour coverage, per-tour persistence, and wait-for-element retry'
